C0_epimer_control.detail: the engine must NOT separate a measured-identical epimer pair (bar: relative difference < 1e-6)

C1_direction.detail: both arms must place daunorubicin as the worse penetrator

C2_noise_floor.detail: the two compounds' readout intervals must be disjoint

R_measured.derivation: central = 50/11; interval = (50-15)/(11+5) to (50+15)/(11-5), i.e. Table 1 fluorescence +- 1 SD combined in the worst-case direction. The effect-based column gives an independent 30/12.

C3_magnitude.detail: strict bar: R_sim in [2.19, 10.83] (measurement's own +-1 SD); loose bar: within 3.0x of 4.55

C4_absolute_ratios.detail: only the daunorubicin row is evidence; doxorubicin is the alpha fit and epirubicin is numerically doxorubicin

C6_far_side_disclosure.measured: statistically indistinguishable across drugs, P > 0.05 (ANOVA), except EPI > DOX at 10 uM x h
C6_far_side_disclosure.detail: NOT SCOREABLE — the paper prints no numeric far-side values. Reported so a right answer cannot be reached by a mechanism the measurement excludes.

C7_near_side_accumulation.detail: REGISTERED AS EXPECTED TO FAIL before the run: the engine solves for FREE interstitial drug and models uptake as a LOSS, not a reservoir, so it cannot accumulate near the source. Reported, not scored.

C5_real_section_informativeness.detail: each compound's half-distance must exceed the source null (10.4 um) by >= 2.0x

measurement.citation: Kyle AH, Huxham LA, Chiam ASJ, Sim DH, Minchinton AI. Direct assessment of drug penetration into tissue using a novel application of three-dimensional cell culture. Cancer Res 2004;64(17):6304-9.
measurement.quantity: ratio of near-side to far-side drug exposure across a multilayered cell culture
measurement.system: HCT-116 human colorectal carcinoma multilayered cell culture (MCC), one-sided 1 h exposure with the far side sealed
measurement.thickness_quote: MCCs frozen immediately after exposure measured 140 +- 15 (SD) um in thickness
measurement.edge_window_quote: the first 30 um of tissue on the near side and far side of MCCs
measurement.gate1_dose_parity_quote: The ratio of fluorescence on each side is calculated from data shown in Fig. 6 using the MCCs frozen immediately after exposure to 10 umol/L drug over 1 hour.
measurement.gate2_species_quote: Only DOX, EPI, and DAU, which all possess the same fluorophore, could be examined. Emission intensities of the three drugs in aqueous solution were within 10% of each other.
measurement.sequestration_quote: DOX appears to accumulate the least over the 1-hour exposure with EPI and DAU reaching ~1.5 and ~7 times higher levels, respectively, on the near sides.
measurement.far_side_indistinguishable_quote: Differences in the effects of the drugs on the far sides of the cultures were found to be statistically indistinguishable, P > 0.05, except at the 10 umol/L x hour exposure, P < 0.005 (ANOVA), where the effect of EPI was significantly greater than DOX.
measurement.near_side_dominance_quote: in both the effect-based assay and direct fluorescence assay, the drugs performed similarly on the far sides of the MCCs regardless of their differing lipophilicity, and it was only on the near sides that their effects could be differentiated.
measurement.n_underlying: n = 4-6 (Fig. 3, SE bars); n for the fluorescence column is not stated in the paper
